ValidationRule.description: BOPI-604 Opportunity and Quote Ship To Account should stay in sync. Created By BOPI-600 updated to prevent auto renewals from stopping
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", Ship_To_Account__c <> SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Ship_To_Account__c, NOT(ISBLANK(Ship_To_Account__c)), NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Type, "Renewal")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If the Ship to Account has changed, you must go back to your Opportunity and create a new quote using the 'New Quote' button
